sent_to_model:
theres a laaitie on the bakkie forum put petrol in his diesel D-Max and hes getting married tomorrow, sitting next to it in the dark now panicking. Kobus is telling him fill up with diesel and drive which is going to kill it properly and the other lady is saying R40 000. help me write him a reply, make him laugh a bit he needs it but tell him straight what to do tonight. dont make it long hes on his phone. tell him what damage he might have done and what it could cost if the pump and injectors are ok, its in my notes. and tell him borrow a bakkie for tomorrow anyway.

- DONT crank it again, every time it turns the pump is running on petrol no lube. leave key out
- tow it, dont drive. inspect pump and injectors for damage first. if no damage, drain tank, flush lines, new fuel filter, bleed it usually R2 500 to R4 500. cant promise total tonight
- my shop Umbilo, open Sat 7 till 12, Thabo my guy can drain it first thing
- most insurance has roadside tow, check his policy before paying a tow guy cash
- dont put diesel on top, petrol still in there, mixing does nothing
- one customer did it twice same year same garage, we made him a sticker for the fuel flap
- my first year as apprentice 1995 i put diesel in the boss's Golf, he still tells it at every braai
- Kobus means well but thats old Land Rover advice, modern common rail cant take it
- already ran, stalled and cranked repeatedly, damage is possible. dont start again, tow for inspection
- borrow a bakkie for the cake anyway, dont plan the wedding round a drained tank
- calm him down, he must laugh, but he must not touch that key
- congrats on the wedding

Thread: HELP put petrol in my diesel D-Max, getting married TOMORROW
(I'm UmbiloSpanner here. I'm replying to Sizwe_DMax_Durbs's message of 2026-11-13T20:11:00.)

---

From: Sizwe_DMax_Durbs | 2026-11-13T19:42:00
Guys please I need help urgently. Filled up at the garage in Westville about 6pm, the attendant asked petrol or diesel and I was on the phone with my fiancee about the seating plan and I said petrol. 45 litres of 95 into my 2019 Isuzu D-Max 2.5 diesel. Drove maybe 3km, it started knocking and jerking and then died at the robot on Jan Smuts. I tried to start it again like 5 or 6 times, it turns but won't catch. Got it pushed into a side road. Wedding is TOMORROW 2pm in Hillcrest and the bakkie is supposed to carry the sound system and the cake. Is the engine finished?? Can I just top up with diesel and go? Please anyone

---

From: Kobus4x4 | 2026-11-13T19:58:00
Ag shame man. Ja just fill it to the top with diesel, the mix will be fine, older diesels can run on a bit of petrol. My oom used to do it in winter. Drive slow and it will burn off.

---

From: Tash_Ballito | 2026-11-13T20:05:00
Congrats on the wedding first of all!! Second, I'm so sorry. My cousin did this and the dealer said the whole injection system was gone, it was like R40 000. Maybe borrow a bakkie for tomorrow? Hope it works out xx

---

[the message I'm replying to] From: Sizwe_DMax_Durbs | 2026-11-13T20:11:00
R40 000?? I'm going to be sick. Kobus should I try the diesel thing now or wait? I'm sitting next to it in the dark. Anyone in Durban who knows what they're doing please

(About me: mechanic who runs a garage, 49, Durban, South Africa. Length: it should come to roughly 250-400 words.)
